_comment: Starter blueprint for Savvy Cyber Kids. The SocialBee module field names and mapping IDs are intentionally placeholders: after import, open that module and remap them using the live fields Make displays. Do not rely on these placeholder field IDs.

metadata._comment: DOUBLE-CHECK/RE-MAP THIS MODULE IN MAKE. SocialBee's exact module and field IDs are rendered by Make's UI and are not publicly documented; the mappings above are starter placeholders for the webhook keys caption, hashtags, graphicUrl, mediaUrl, postId, and socialBeeWorkspaceId.
